nodes.label: Ceylon Stack Frontend Guide - Binding Rules
Frontend API Layer - Single Source of Truth Pattern
nodes.rationale: lib/erpnext.ts is only place talking to ERPNext. All documents follow same list/detail/form pattern. Shared components reused, never forked. Business logic stays in ERPNext.

nodes.label: Frontend - Master Data Canonicalization
nodes.rationale: Items/Item Groups/Price Lists moved to /master-data/ 2026-09-18. Customers/Contacts/Suppliers moved 2026-09-19. Warehouses moved same day. Old /sales /buying paths 307-redirect. Batch/Serial deliberately stay operational (not masters).

nodes.label: Frontend - Stock Balance List vs Report Distinction
nodes.rationale: /stock/stock-balance backed by live Bin (current qty). Reports 'Stock Balance' queries Stock Ledger snapshot as-of-date with valuation. Different answers (now vs. then), different screens, no collapse.
